specification.name: Personal Financial Modeling Canonical Schema
specification.description: Canonical domain and simulation specification from which database schemas, validation code, dependency resolution, accounting postings, and simulation-engine interfaces can be derived.
specification.source_basis: User-provided prior-conversation summary and the previously established conceptual model.
design_principles: Core domain objects represent financial entities and facts; derived statements and metrics are computed.
Temporal behavior is compositional rather than a single mutually exclusive type.
Transactions are accounting realizations of economic activity and may contain multiple accounting legs.
Events modify state, behavior, or relationships and may be scheduled, conditional, stochastic, or dependency-driven.
Assumptions parameterize future behavior and are scenario-scoped unless explicitly global.
Scenarios select coherent alternate assumptions, events, and decisions.
Dependency graphs are directed acyclic graphs within a time slice unless an explicitly stateful recurrence is declared.
Simulation operates by state transition across discrete timesteps.
Database persistence must preserve immutable historical facts and reproducible simulation inputs.
Validation invariants are first-class parts of the specification.

conventions.enum_extension: closed-by-default; new enum members require specification-version change
conventions.null_semantics: null means unknown/not-applicable unless field definition says otherwise
conventions.signed_effects: accounting effect amounts are signed relative to the target account/classification

Person.description: Individual human participant in the financial model.
object_invariants: date_of_birth < date_of_death when date_of_death is not null

Household.description: Economic household grouping one or more persons.
object_invariants: formation_date < dissolution_date when dissolution_date is not null

Account.description: Financial account or container that holds cash, investments, or tax-advantaged assets.
object_invariants: closing_date is null or closing_date >= opening_date
current_balance equals opening_balance plus signed cash-flow legs posted to the account

Asset.description: Owned economic resource with a modeled value.
object_invariants: sale_date is null or acquisition_date is null or sale_date >= acquisition_date
current_balance <= principal + cumulative_new_draws - cumulative_principal_payments when applicable
maturity_date is null or maturity_date > origination_date

Income.description: Projected or realized inflow to a person or household.
object_invariants: end_date is null or end_date >= start_date

Expense.description: Projected or realized outflow incurred by a person or household.
object_invariants: end_date is null or end_date >= start_date

Transaction.description: Atomic realized financial activity represented by one or more accounting legs.
object_invariants: every transaction has at least two accounting legs
sum of monetary debit legs equals sum of monetary credit legs
transaction legs have the same transaction_id
all legs share transaction currency unless explicit FX legs are present

Event.description: Discrete occurrence that can modify financial state, behavior, relationships, or future schedules.
object_invariants: end_date is null or end_date >= start_date

Scenario.description: Coherent simulation configuration containing assumptions, events, and decision policies.
object_invariants: base_scenario_id is null or base_scenario_id != scenario_id

Assumption.description: Scenario-scoped parameter representing an explicit belief about future conditions.
object_invariants: end_date is null or start_date is null or end_date >= start_date
distribution_type is not null iff stochastic behavior is intended

Investment.description: Position or strategy held in an Account and valued through an investment model.
object_invariants: market_value = quantity * price unless the valuation model explicitly defines another formula

Insurance.description: Insurance policy that transforms specified financial risks into premiums, deductibles, coverage, and claims.

TaxRule.description: Jurisdiction- and date-scoped tax or tax-advantaged-account rule.
object_invariants: expiration_date is null or expiration_date >= effective_date
progressive brackets must be ordered and non-overlapping

PrimitiveInstance.description: Configured instance of a registered time-series primitive.

DependencyNode.description: Node in the financial dependency graph.

object_invariants: self-loop forbidden unless explicitly marked as stateful recurrence
non-stateful dependency subgraph must be acyclic

EventEffect.description: State or flow modification emitted by an Event.

AccountingLeg.description: One balanced debit/credit posting generated by a Transaction.
object_invariants: posting_type plus effect_type must be semantically valid

semantics.equation_or_rule: X_t = V if t = t* else 0
X_t = f(t) for a <= t <= b else 0
X_t = L_k for t in interval k
activate effect when event condition is true
X_t = f1 if C else f2

node_types.event: Discrete event trigger or event state.
node_types.simulation_output: Persisted result of a simulation run.

semantics.reads: Target calculation reads source node without mutating it.
semantics.modifies: Source event/rule changes target model or state.
semantics.triggers: Source becoming true activates target behavior/event.
semantics.constrains: Source imposes a valid-domain restriction on target.
semantics.aggregates: Target is an aggregation over one or more source nodes.

rules: Within a timestep, non-stateful read/derive dependencies must be acyclic.
Cycles are permitted only when at least one node represents carried state from a prior timestep.
A stateful recurrence must declare an explicit lag >= 1 or equivalent prior-state reference.
Evaluation order is topological after expanding event precedence and lagged state boundaries.
Conflicting writes to the same target require explicit priority; equal-priority conflicting writes are invalid.
Derived nodes cannot be direct write targets of user-authored transactions.
Event-triggered modifications are evaluated before downstream derived calculations.

accounting.transaction_rule: Every realized transaction must generate at least two legs and total debits must equal total credits in each currency.

posting_type.debit: Increase in asset/expense or decrease in liability/equity, subject to account semantics.
posting_type.credit: Increase in liability/equity/income or decrease in asset/expense, subject to account semantics.

effect_type_semantics.equity: Residual net-worth/equity change not classified as income/expense.
effect_type_semantics.gain: Increase in net worth from asset valuation/disposal classified as gain.
effect_type_semantics.loss: Decrease in net worth from valuation/disposal classified as loss.
effect_type_semantics.cash: Cash movement; normally represented through an asset leg for a cash account.

mortgage_payment.note: Interest may be tax-reclassified but remains an expense component in personal income/cash-flow modeling unless the statement convention explicitly separates it.

account_transfer.note: Transfers between accounts are excluded from consolidated household cash-flow totals.

roth_conversion.tax_overlay: Separate tax transaction generated from TaxRule.

invariants: BeginningInvestmentValue + Purchases - Sales + Returns + Income = EndingInvestmentValue, subject to explicit classification conventions
Every posted transaction is balanced per currency
Consolidated internal transfers do not change household net worth or consolidated cash

state_transition.notation: S[t+1] = F(S[t], Flow[t], Event[t], Dependency[t], Assumption[t], RandomState[t], Scenario)

deterministic_requirements: Same immutable inputs, specification version, seed (if stochastic), and engine version must reproduce the same run.
stochastic_requirements: Random draws are isolated by named stochastic process.
Random processes may declare correlation groups.
Each run records engine version and specification version.

schema_level: All UUID references resolve to the correct object type.
All enum values belong to their declared enumeration.
All monetary values use declared currency.
Derived fields are not directly user-authored as authoritative inputs.
domain_level: A Person belongs to zero or one Household at any timestep unless household-sharing semantics explicitly allow otherwise.
A Household contains at least one Person.
An Account has exactly one owner.
An Asset and Liability owner must be a Person or Household.
Income and Expense end dates cannot precede start dates.
Liability balance cannot become negative unless the specific liability model explicitly permits a credit balance.
Investment quantity and price cannot be negative under the standard long-only model.
TaxRule effective intervals cannot overlap for the same unique rule key unless explicit precedence exists.
accounting_level: For each currency, total debit amount equals total credit amount per Transaction.
Consolidated Balance Sheet equation holds at every timestep.
Consolidated cash-flow roll-forward holds at every timestep.
No transaction can simultaneously increase and decrease the same atomic balance in an ambiguous way without separate legs.
Internal account transfers must net to zero at household consolidation.
dependency_level: No unintended cycles in a single-timestep dependency graph.
All stateful recurrences identify prior-state inputs.
All event effects reference valid targets.
Topological evaluation order is valid after lag expansion.
simulation_level: Every timestep produces a valid state or a classified hard failure.
All validation failures are recorded with object/node/field context.
Stochastic runs record seed and run ID.
Simulation outputs reference the exact scenario and specification version used.

severity.error: Simulation/model is invalid and cannot be considered authoritative.
severity.warning: Model may run, but user should be alerted to ambiguity or unusual assumptions.

income_statement.equation: NetIncome = GrossIncome - Taxes - Expenses + Gains - Losses

core_metrics.total_assets: sum(asset values + account cash + investment values, with no double counting)
core_metrics.taxes: sum recognized tax expense/outflow according to statement convention
core_metrics.expenses: sum recognized household expenses excluding transfers
core_metrics.liquidity: liquid assets / modeled mandatory near-term outflows
core_metrics.debt_service_ratio: mandatory debt service / gross income when gross_income > 0

derived_outputs.non_authoritative_rule: Derived outputs are recalculated from authoritative state, flows, transactions, rules, and assumptions and are not independently stored as source-of-truth inputs.
